key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent into a trajectory-level RL objective for autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, avoiding intermediate value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free training recipe for reasoning LLMs that can simplify implementation and reduce instability from state-value estimation in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
method: Reformulate PMD using Bellman equations over full trajectories instead of intermediate states.
Derive a practical loss whose mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
Optimize directly from terminal rewards for autoregressive text generation.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO demonstrates effectiveness compared with prior approaches.
watch_item: Because the practical loss uses an approximation and a smoothed mismatch-correction weight, performance may depend on how well that approximation matches the true trajectory objective.
